## Instructions (this block does not appear in the Word document)

With your group, you will write a quiz for your classmates to take. Your group
has been assigned **either MVPA or CFA**. Write your quiz on that topic.

**Requirements**

- First identify the key concepts needed to understand the model you were assigned.
- Write at least 5 questions reflecting the key concepts.
- Questions should be a general review of the topic, open ended, and ask quiz-takers to demonstrate their understanding of the model.
- Refer back to previous lectures and course materials.
- Focus on key concepts to understand the model.
  - No yes/no or single-word answers. 
  - Should require some synthesis of information not copy/paste from the slides/materials.
- For every question, write the expected answer in the teacher block under it.

**Course materials**

- [Lectures](https://srdevore.github.io/edep_625_sem/lectures.html)
- [R labs](https://srdevore.github.io/edep_625_sem/labs.html)

**How to use this template**

1. Replace the placeholders in the title and author fields above.
2. Write your questions and your expected answers below.
3. Render the **student** version. This is the file you post
   and share with the class:

   ```bash
   quarto render widgets/review_quiz.qmd --to docx --profile student
   ```

4. Render the **teacher** version (questions and expected answers) to check
   the quiz-takers' work:

   ```bash
   quarto render widgets/review_quiz.qmd --to docx --profile teacher
   ```

:::
